evidence: This study examined the effect of the process sequence on the composition of doped ﬁlms grown by atomic layer deposition by investigating the passivation effect of one precursor on the chemisorption of another in the subsequent step. Considering that Ti/H20849O–i–C3H7/H208504 /H20849TTIP/H20850and Al/H20849CH3/H208503 /H20849TMA/H20850do not react with each other, Al-doped TiO 2 ﬁlms were grown by ALD through various process sequences.
